name: EcommerceKit
summary: Next.js e-commerce starter kit with authentication, email and payments pre-integrated.
description: A Next.js store starter template that includes an authentication system, mailing integration and payment integration, plus the components, blocks, hooks and state stores needed for a shop. Start from the repo or the live demo and customise it into your own storefront.
contains: Next.js starter template for an e-commerce site
pre-integrated authentication, email and payment systems
ships components, blocks, hooks and stores directories
shadcn/ui components.json plus Tailwind CSS and TypeScript
